panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 17 | Pressure and scale structure of the pre-departure paired contrasts. Each cell shows a saved temporary-minus-final mean in its original unit. The first three panels compare 500, 700 and 850 hPa; layer-input panels retain the 500–850 hPa boundary difference. Columns are the three distinct nominal scale windows, not equally spaced continuous coordinates. Each quantity has its own symmetric zero-centred colour scale; missing estimates are grey and are not interpreted as zero. Tables S7b,c,d give the estimates, paired SID counts and intervals at the three common pressure levels and for the 500–850 hPa layer. The accompanying source data also provide the 13-level storage, local-tendency and horizontal diagnostics. Table S7n defines the quantities. The panels use the main input placement and 0–300 km region; colour does not encode significance.
